# Coworking Space Al Reem Island — Aegis Coworking

> Aegis Coworking - ADGM runs a coworking space on Level 38 of Addax Tower (Office 3812), Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates — inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) jurisdiction. Hot desks are AED 1,000 per month, dedicated desks AED 1,150, day passes AED 100 and private offices from AED 4,500 per month.

Focus: People who live and work on Al Reem Island and local teams who want a workspace on the island.

This site (coworkingspacealreemisland.online) is a one-page guide to the Aegis coworking space on Al Reem Island, published by Aegis Coworking.

Last Updated: 2026-10-07

## Key facts

- Location: Level 38, Office 3812, Addax Tower, Al Reem Island — inside ADGM (24.4989303, 54.4031693)
- Hot desk (flexi desk): AED 1,000 per month — shared coworking floor, fibre-optic internet, meeting room credits, community events, coffee and tea; no licence address
- Dedicated desk: AED 1,150 per month (one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee) — own desk, 24/7 access, locker, extra meeting room credits, office address suitable for an ADGM licence
- Day pass: AED 100 per day — shared floor, WiFi, coffee and tea, print and scan, no commitment
- Private office: from AED 4,500 per month — furnished, configurable layout, ADGM licence address
- Virtual office: from AED 292 per month — registered ADGM business address and mail handling
- Meeting rooms: hourly booking; members receive monthly credits
- No deposit, no admin or setup fees, free registration; ADGM government fees separate
- Contact: +971 50 392 6316 · WhatsApp https://wa.me/971503926316 · contact@aegiscoworking.ae
- Tours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM
